Mammary Tuberculosis: Histopathologic evaluation: granulomas with central caseaous necrosis
Physical examination: tender, erythematous mass in the left breast with sinus tract
Histopathologic evaluation: epitheloid histiocytes, Langhans' giant cells
Histopathologic evaluation: intense lymphocytic infiltration at the periphery of the granulomas
Associated symptoms: sinus tract and low-grade fever
Ultrasound findings: 3 cm ill-defined, hypoechoic, heterogeneous lesion in the upper-inner quadrant
